Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)

library(readxl)
Unemployment_Data <- read_excel("~/Downloads/Unemployment Data.xlsx")

```



```{r}
path <- "~/Downloads/Unemployment Data.xlsx"

# find the real header row ("Country Name")
peek <- read_excel(path, col_names = FALSE)
hdr  <- which(apply(peek, 1, function(r) any(r == "Country Name", na.rm = TRUE)))[1]

unemp <- read_excel(path, skip = hdr - 1)

names(unemp)

```

```{r plot}
unemp |>
  filter(`Country Name` %in% c("United States", "Canada", "United Kingdom",
                               "Germany", "France", "Japan", "Thailand",
                               "Puerto Rico", "Uruguay", "Mexico",
                               "Argentina", "South Africa", "Nepal")) |>
  select(country = `Country Name`, `2000.0`:`2024.0`) |>
  pivot_longer(-country, names_to = "yr", values_to = "rate") |>
  mutate(yr = as.numeric(yr), rate = as.numeric(rate)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yr, y = rate, color = country)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  labs(title = "Unemployment Rate, 2000-2025",
       x = NULL, y = "Unemployment rate (%)", color = "Country") +
  theme_minimal()

```
